title: Role of hinge motion and ATP dynamics in factors for inversion stimulation FIS protein deduced while targeting drug resistant Orientia tsutsugamushi.
authors: Parvaiz, Nousheen; Shahbaz, Maham; Azam, Syed Sikander
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接和MD模拟研究FIS蛋白与抑制剂的结合及构象变化，虽涉及蛋白-DNA结合域，但核心是药物靶点发现而非TF-DNA互作机制建模，方法可迁移但对象偏离。
abstract: Orientia tsutsugamushi, the causative agent of scrub typhus has been found resistant to various classes of antibiotics such as penicillins, gentamycin and cephalosporins. Review of current literature suggests that the prevalence of scrub typhus has increased globally. Therefore, the current study has aimed at exploring the genome of O. tsutsugamushi to identify potential drug target proteins that can be used for developing novel antibiotics against the pathogen. Subtractive proteomics approach has revealed FIS as a potential drug target protein involved in two component system (TCS), a signaling pathway crucial for bacteria to survive and adjust in changing environmental conditions. Molecular docking studies have revealed compound-356 (CHEMBRIDGE-10040641-3710.356) as a potential inhibitor in both chains A and B of the FIS protein. Simulation results suggest that the docked complex has remained stable and compact throughout the 200 ns run. Significant conformational changes including the hinge motion was observed in the DNA binding domain. Furthermore, the presence of salt bridge between GLU910 and ARG417, rearrangement of interaction residues and displacement of ATP in the central AAA + domain upon binding to the inhibitor were also observed playing a role in stabilizing the protein structure.
abstract_zh: Orientia tsutsugamushi，恙虫病的病原体，已被发现对多种抗生素类别具有耐药性，如青霉素类、庆大霉素和头孢菌素类。对当前文献的回顾表明，恙虫病的患病率在全球范围内有所增加。因此，本研究旨在探索O. tsutsugamushi的基因组，以识别潜在的药物靶蛋白，可用于开发针对该病原体的新型抗生素。减法蛋白质组学方法揭示了FIS作为潜在的药物靶蛋白，参与双组分系统（TCS），这是一种对细菌在变化环境条件下生存和适应至关重要的信号通路。分子对接研究表明，化合物-356（CHEMBRIDGE-10040641-3710.356）是FIS蛋白A链和B链的潜在抑制剂。模拟结果表明，对接复合物在200 ns运行期间保持稳定和紧凑。在DNA结合域中观察到显著的构象变化，包括铰链运动。此外，在抑制剂结合后，中央AAA+域中GLU910和ARG417之间盐桥的存在、相互作用残基的重排以及ATP的位移也被观察到在稳定蛋白质结构中发挥作用。
